Tomas Brandt
Chicago, IL, USA
tomas.brandt@example.com
+1 555 0123

October 20, 2026

Dana Whitfield
Talent Acquisition
Northwind Freight Inc.
220 West Lake Street, Suite 1400
Chicago, IL 60606

Application for Senior FP&A Analyst, Req #NW-4471

Dear Dana Whitfield,

Northwind's FP&A team needs forecasts that Operations and Sales leaders can trust. At Calder Industrial Components I raised forecast accuracy for our larger business unit from 88% to 96% by rebuilding the model around order backlog. I now own the monthly forecast and variance reporting for two business units with combined revenue of about 85 million USD.

That is the same work you describe for your Midwest and Southeast regions: monthly forecasting and variance analysis, plus budgeting with regional leaders. At Redfern Stores I prepared the annual budget for the regional team. At Calder I cut month-end close reporting from 9 working days to 6 by automating journal checks in Excel VBA, which speaks to your goal of faster, more accurate month-end reporting. I build Power BI dashboards for plant managers, so turning complex data into clear recommendations for non-finance stakeholders is part of my week. I also work in advanced Excel and basic SQL, and I'm working towards my ACCA qualification with 9 of 13 papers passed.

I'd like to talk about how this experience could support your hybrid Chicago team. I'm available for a conversation at your convenience and can start the process whenever suits you.

Kind regards,
Tomas Brandt
